ld.name: Nubian Heritage, Liquid Hand Soap, Patchouli & Buriti, 12 fl oz (355 ml)
ld.description: Glowing & Uplifting Infused With: Rosehip Seed Oil Certified B Corporation Cruelty Free Ethically Traded Ingredients Sustainably Sourced No Animal Testing This gentle, sulfate-free liquid hand soap, infused with Patchouli Oil, Shea Butter, and Buriti Oil, cleanses without drying. Leaves hands smooth and refreshed while senses are uplifted with an exotic fragrance. Humble Beginnings Born on the streets of Harlem in 1992, but based on centuries old traditions, Nubian Heritage has been guided by the legacy of ancient Nubia, the world's first melting pot. Ancient Nubia was once a center of cultural trade - a place where goods, ideas and customs from across Africa, Asia, the Middle East and the Mediterranean came together, influenced each other, and then spread across the ancient world. That is our inspiration. We bring together cultural wisdom and indigenous ingredients to create modern wellness solutions for skin and hair. Our mission is to make cultural exchange the model for transforming the global community and personal care. Heritage Buriti Oil is made from the fruit of Moriche Palm, known as the "tree of life," because of its importance in the Amazonian diet. Emphasizing this collection's brightening properties, our package symbolizes happiness. The pattern is representative of Thailand's textile industry, which economically empowers countless communities and employs over one million individuals.

paragraphs: Water, sodium lauroyl methyl isethionate, cocamidopropyl betaine, glycerin (vegetable), propanediol, aloe barbadensis leaf juice, butyrospermum parkii (shea) butter*♥, theobroma grandiflorum (cupuaçu) seed butter, macadamia ternifolia seed oil, rosa canina (dog rose) seed oil, mauritia flexuosa (buriti) fruit oil, tocopherol, calendula officinalis (calendula) flower extract, camellia sinensis (green tea) leaf extract, sodium chloride, guar hydroxypropyltrimonium chloride, triethyl citrate, trisodium ethylenediamine disuccinate, glycine soja (soybean) oil, sodium benzoate, caprylyl glycol, benzoic acid, fragrance.
